做有复利的事。
hero.subtitle: LEAN BODY. STRONG MIND.

voices.name: 孙宇晨
voices.quote: Muscle is the most important bank account in your body. You can be financially rich and still be physically poor.

voices.name: 自己造船的路飞
voices.quote: I never really had that youthful fire. Building lean muscle is the first step toward reclaiming it—because it’s the one thing that depends entirely on you, not fate.

voices.name: 陈昌文
voices.quote: The level of the five people around you determines your wealth. Take on people above your level. Don’t let those below it drag you down.

voices.name: 峰哥
voices.quote: Every problem young people have comes down to sexual frustration. And all that frustration comes from not having lean muscle.

voices.name: Jack叔叔
voices.quote: Jack puts lean-muscle theory to the test. His two-hour livestream took it from physical training to mindset. Viewers call him the “Chief Method Extractor.”
